title: OpenAI Recognizer Options
description: OpenAI Whisper/Realtime specific STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'openai'.

apiKey.description: OpenAI API key. Overrides credentials configured in jambonz.

prompt.description: Prompt to guide the recognition model.

hintsTemplate.description: Template for injecting hints into the prompt.

languages.description: Language hints for 'gpt-live-transcribe', which takes a list rather than a single code (e.g. ['en','fr']). Overrides the recognizer language; do not combine with 'language'.

keywords.description: Literal term hints (product names, acronyms, medications) for 'gpt-live-transcribe'. Hints, not required output. Defaults to the recognizer's 'hints' when unset.

delay.description: Latency/accuracy trade-off for 'gpt-live-transcribe': lower emits partial text sooner, higher gives the model more audio context and can improve accuracy.

turn_detection.description: Turn detection configuration for the OpenAI Realtime API.

eagerness.description: How eagerly the model should respond.

prefix_padding_ms.description: Milliseconds of audio to include before detected speech.

silence_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds of silence to detect end of speech.

vadMode.description: Local VAD aggressiveness (0-3). Used only with the client-endpointed models ('gpt-live-transcribe', 'gpt-realtime-whisper'), which reject server turn detection and rely on jambonz to end each turn.

vadSilenceMs.description: Milliseconds of silence to detect end-of-speech for local VAD. Used only with the client-endpointed models.

vadVoiceMs.description: Milliseconds of voice to detect start-of-speech for local VAD. Used only with the client-endpointed models.
